title: When the Portrait Burns
author: Rafael Marchetti
blurb: Marguerite Thackeray, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
